page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m4.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 24 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of memory, delivering a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU. It operates without dedicated hardware accelerators, featuring zero GPUs.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of network-attached block storage for operating systems and persistent data. In terms of network capabilities, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps, while including zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires network traffic to be routed via separate cloud networking configurations such as elastic IP addresses or NAT gateways.

The 1:4 memory allocation suits standard business enterprise applications that demand reliable compute capacity without disproportionate memory or storage overhead. While the absence of local NVMe storage limits single-node disk I/O performance to external block volumes, the 24 dedicated Intel cores and 12 Gbps network baseline make it appropriate for enterprise web serving, mid-sized database management systems, continuous integration pipelines, and distributed application runtimes.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m4.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance within the ecs.u2i family, designed for balanced production workloads. Powered by the x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.7 GHz, it features 24 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes no onboard GPUs and comes with no local storage, relying on network-attached storage for disk operations. Network performance is anchored by a 12 Gbps baseline throughput, and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. Driven by the KVM hypervisor, ecs.u2i-c1m4.6xlarge offers a balanced resource layout suitable for multi-tier web applications, relational and in-memory databases, build automation systems, and enterprise back-office software.
